book.name: Yoohana
book.title: Amangʼana Amazʉmu ga Yɨɨsu Kiriisitʉ chɨmbu gaandikirwɨ na Yoohana

content: “Nɨbhabhuuriirɨ gʉʉsi ganʉ korereke mʉtatiga kunyiisirirya.
Nawe abhaatʉ bharabha bharabhaahʉra imwɨ mʉmarwazɨrʉ gaabhʉ. Rɨraaza ribhaga rɨnʉ ʉmʉʉtʉ wʉwʉʉsi arabhiita, ariiseega kʉbha arakora emeremo ja Mungu.
Bharabhakorerabhu, kʉ kʉbha bhatɨɨzɨ Bhaabha, nʉʉrʉ inyɨ, bhatanyɨzɨ.

Nawe nɨbhabhuuriirɨ gayo, korereke ribhaga ryabhʉ ryo okokora gayo hanʉ rikuhika, muhiitɨ kʉbha nɨkabhabhʉʉrɨra. Emeremo je Ekoro Ɨndɨndu “Nɨtabhabhuuriirɨ gayo gʉʉsi mʉbhʉtangɨ, kʉ kʉbha naarɨ hamwɨmwɨ na niimwɨ.
Mmbe, nangʉ nɨraja kwa Bhaabha wʉnʉ antumirɨ kwa niimwɨ. Nawe atareeho wʉwʉʉsi gatɨgatɨ waanyu wʉnʉ akumbuurya, ‘Nangʉ, ʉraja hayi?’
Murumikirɨ bhʉkʉngʼu mozekoro zaanyu kʉ kʉbha nɨrabhabhʉʉrɨra nɨraja kwa Bhaabha.
“Nɨrabhabhʉʉrɨra amaheene kʉbha, nɨraja kwa Bhaabha. Arɨɨbhɨ nɨtakuja, Ʉmʉsakirya wurya atakʉtʉra kuuza kwa niimwɨ. Nawe inyɨ niriijɨ, nɨramʉtʉma kwa niimwɨ.
Hanʉ akuuza, arabha arabheerecha abhaatʉ bha kʉʉsɨ kʉnʉ amangʼana igʉrʉ wʉ ʉbhʉbhɨ, eheene nɨ ɨtɨnɨrʉ.
Arabha arabheerecha ebho kʉbha nɨ‑bhakʉri bhʉ ʉbhʉbhɨ, kʉ kʉbha bhatakunyiisirirya.
Areerecha kʉbha inyɨ ne‑we eheene kʉ kʉbha nɨraja kwa Bhaabha na mʉtakondora kwikɨ.
Arabha arabheerecha habhwɨrʉ kʉbha Mungu arabhatɨnɨra, kʉ kʉbha amutiniirɨ Shɨtaani ʉmʉkangati wɨ ɨɨsɨ.
“Nɨkɨɨrɨ nɨnago maaru gʉ ʉkʉbhabhʉʉrɨra, nawe ribhaga rɨnʉ mʉtakʉtʉra kogoobhoora.
Ekoro ya amaheene yiyo, hanʉ ikuuza kwa niimwɨ, ɨrabhakangata komenya amaheene gʉʉsi. Ɨtakʉgamba kʉbhʉnaja bhwazɨ umwene, nawe ɨragamba ganʉ igwirɨ na kʉbhabhʉʉrɨra ganʉ gareerorekanɨ.
Ekoro yiyo ɨrabha ɨrangʉnga, kʉ kʉbha ɨrabhabhʉʉrɨra gʉʉsi ganʉ ibhwɨnɨ kurwa kwa niinyɨ.
Ebhegero bhyʉsi bhɨnʉ Bhaabha anabhyʉ ibhyanɨ. Necho nɨgambirɨ kʉbha Ekoro yiyo ɨrabhabhʉʉrɨra gʉʉsi ganʉ ɨkʉbha ibhwɨnɨ kurwa kwa niinyɨ.
Ɨbhɨgʉngi bhiriichʉra kʉbha obhozomerwa
“Rɨkɨɨrɨ ibhaga isuuhu mʉtakondora, akʉmara ibhaga isuuhu naatu mʉrandora.”
Mmbe, abhɨɨga bhaazɨ obhorebhe bhakiibhuurya, “Ana nzobhoorokɨ hanʉ akubhuga, ‘Rɨkɨɨrɨ ibhaga isuuhu mʉtakondora, akʉmara ibhaga isuuhu naatu mʉrandora,’ na ‘Nɨraja kwa Bhaabha’?”
Mmbe, bhakangʼeha kwibhuurya, “Enzobhooro yaku nɨkɨ, ‘Rɨkɨɨrɨ ibhaga isuuhu?’ Tʉtakwobhoora ganʉ akʉgamba.”

Yɨɨsu akamenya kʉbha bhareenda kumubhuurya ganʉ agambirɨ, mmbe akabhabhuurya, “Nangʉ, muriibhuurya ganʉ nɨgambirɨ, ‘Rɨkɨɨrɨ ibhaga isuuhu na niimwɨ mʉtakondora, akʉmara ibhaga isuuhu naatu mʉrandora’?
Nɨrabhabhʉʉrɨra amaheene, imwɨ mʉrarɨra na kurumɨka, nawe abhaatʉ bhɨ ɨɨsɨ yɨnʉ bharazomerwa. Mʉrarumɨka, nawe ɨbhɨgʉngi bhyanyu bhiriichʉra kʉbha obhozomerwa.
Arɨɨbhɨ ʉmʉkari araja kwibhʉra umwana, ararumɨka kʉ kʉbha ribhaga ryɨ ɨnyaakʉ yaazɨ rihikirɨ. Nawe hanʉ akʉmara kwibhʉra, atakuhiita naatu ɨnyaakʉ yiyo kʉ kʉbha yo obhozomerwa bhu ukwibhurwa umwana.
Mmbe imwʉsi mʉrarumɨka ribhaga rɨnʉ. Nawe nɨraaza naatu kwa niimwɨ, na niimwɨ mʉrabha no obhozomerwa mozekoro zaanyu. Atareeho wʉnʉ akuruusha obhozomerwa bhuyo mozekoro zaanyu.
Hanʉ ribhaga riyo rikuhika, mʉtakumbuurya ingʼana ryʉryʉsi. “Nɨrabhabhʉʉrɨra amaheene, gʉʉsi ganʉ mʉkʉsabha kuriina ryanɨ, Bhaabha arabhaha.
Kuhika nangwɨnʉ, mʉkɨɨrɨ kʉsabha chʉchʉsi kʉhɨtɨra iriina ryanɨ. Mʉsabhɨ, na niimwɨ mʉrabhona, korereke obhozomerwa bhwanyu bhuhikɨ.
Yɨɨsu ahizirɨ ɨɨsɨ
“Nɨbhabhuuriirɨ gʉʉsi gayo kʉnzɨra ye ebherenjo. Nawe ribhaga rɨrahika nɨtakʉgamba na niimwɨ kʉnzɨra ye ebherenjo, nawe nɨrabhabhʉʉrɨra habhwɨrʉ igʉrʉ wa Bhaabha.
Kwibhaga riyo, mʉrasabha kʉhɨtɨra iriina ryanɨ. Na nɨtakʉbhabhʉʉrɨra kʉbha inyɨ nɨrabhasabhɨra kwa Bhaabha.
Ewe umwene abhasɨɨgirɨ imwɨ, kʉ kʉbha imwɨ mʉnsɨɨgirɨ inyɨ, na mwisiriiryɨ kʉbha nɨkarwa kwa Bhaabha.
Nɨkaaza kʉʉsɨ kʉnʉ kurwa kwa Bhaabha, nawe nangʉ nɨrarwa kʉʉsɨ kʉnʉ, nɨraja kwa Bhaabha.”
Neho abhɨɨga bhaazɨ bhakamʉbhʉʉrɨra, “Nangʉ ʉtangirɨ kʉgamba na niitwɨ habhwɨrʉ ɨtarɨ kʉnzɨra ye ebherenjo.
Nangʉ twʉbhʉʉrirɨ kʉbha ʉmɨnyirɨ gʉʉsi, na ʉtakwenda mʉʉtʉ akubhuuryɨ ryʉryʉsi. Gayo nego gagiriryɨ kwisirirya kʉbha ʉkarwa kwa Mungu.”
Yɨɨsu akabhabhuurya, “Nangʉ mwisiriiryɨ?
Ribhaga rɨraariirɨ, naatu rihikirɨ, hanʉ bhʉʉsi mʉraanyaraganɨ na kuja ɨwaanyu na kuntiga inyimwene. Nawe nɨtakʉbha inyimwene, kʉ kʉbha Bhaabha arɨ hamwɨmwɨ na niinyɨ.
Nɨbhabhuuriirɨ gayo gʉʉsi korereke mʉbhɨ no omorembe mozekoro zaanyu, kʉ kʉbha mʉrɨ kwa niinyɨ. Kʉʉsɨ hanʉ mʉrabhona zɨnyaakʉ nzaru, nawe mʉtʉʉbhaha kʉ kʉbha inyɨ nihizirɨ ɨɨsɨ.”
